annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1539/2024 - Institui o Fundo de Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento e Inovação da Indústria de Inteligência Artificial (Fidia)
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1539/2024 - Establishing the Fund for Incentive to Development and Innovation of the Artificial Intelligence Industry (Fidia)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Carlos Henrique Gaguim)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 1539/2024 creating Fidia, a fund to stimulate AI investment and development and reduce regional inequalities. It defines AI systems, providers and operators, sets a managing council under the science ministry, and funds the scheme through budget allocations and a 0.25% levy on AI agents' gross revenue.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates Fidia to fund AI development and expand societal access to AI services
Defines AI system, provider, operator and AI agents
Managing Council under Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation sets priorities and issues annual report
Revenue includes budget allocations, donations and 0.25% levy on gross operating revenue of AI agents
